requirements.title: E and D descriptor widths, fractional digits, exponent digits, and input e effect
requirements.definition: E w.d, D w.d, and E w.d E e occupy w positions except w=0 selects output width; fractional part has d digits unless scale factor greater than one; positive e fixes exponent digits and otherwise the minimum is used; e has no input effect.

S13.7.2.3.3-001 E/D-editing runtime fixtures: complete internal-file programs use exact default-real values, SS sign mode, and descriptors chosen to avoid processor latitude. (SS,2P,E10.3E2) of 0.5 expects ' 50.00E-02' and proves the ten-position field; (SS,1P,E9.2E2) expects ' 1.00E+00' and proves d=2 fractional digits; (SS,2P,E11.3E3) of 0.5 expects ' 50.00E-002' and proves explicit E3 exponent digits. A sentinel-guarded input fixture reads '1E+1' with E4.0E2 and E4.0 and requires both exact results to be 10.0, proving e has no input effect. Descriptor and sentinel substitutions are permanent and fail.

S13.7.2.3.3-004 finite E-output runtime fixtures: complete internal-file programs write exact 1.0 with (SS,E10.3E2) at scale factor zero. Because 13.8.5 makes the zero immediately left of the decimal optional for E editing, fixtures assert only invariant slices: field(3:10)=='.100E+01', field(3:3)=='.', field(4:6)=='100', and field(7:10)=='E+01'. Right justification keeps these positions fixed whether the optional leading zero is printed or suppressed. Descriptor substitutions to ES, EN, F, changed d, and changed e fail.

requirements.title: Table 13.1 enumerates E and D exponent forms
requirements.definition: Table 13.1 gives the row-by-row permitted exponent forms for E and D output, including E w.d, E w.d E e, E0.d, D w.d, and D0.d cases and the rule for z digits, s minimum digits, and zero exponent plus sign.

pending.table13_1_D0_d_any: Unassertable as one exact string: Table 13.1 permits either D±z1...zs or E±z1...zs for D0.d; the D/E letter choice is latitude.

requirements.title: Scale factor controls E/D decimal normalization and permitted k range
requirements.definition: Scale factor k controls E/D decimal normalization: for -d<k<=0, exactly |k| leading zeros and d-|k| significant digits follow the decimal symbol; for 0<k<d+2, exactly k significant digits precede it and d-k+1 follow; other k values are not permitted.

pending.E-D-scale-factor-range: Source-control only: a format with k outside the permitted interval changes only scale factor; no diagnostic facet is filed for this unnumbered restriction.
